segments.text: Gumgumi is chatting with one friend at a noisy party.
It feels like every other voice just goes silent.
But say your name, and you catch it instantly.
The reason is hiding inside your brain.
Your brain picks one voice to hear clearly.
But it keeps quietly tracking the other voices too.
A familiar sound, like your name, suddenly stands out.
Right then, your brain snaps its attention over there.
That's called the cocktail party effect.
So even in a noisy room, your name always gets through.
